title: Israel’s Rapid Succession of Kings

questions.question: Which prophet spoke against Baasha?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:1 (ESV): "And the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha..."

questions.question: Who killed Elah son of Baasha while he was drunk?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:9-10 (ESV): "His servant Zimri... struck him down and killed him..."

questions.question: How long did Zimri reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:15 (ESV): "In the twenty-seventh year of Asa... Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah."

questions.question: Who built the city of Samaria?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:24 (ESV): "He bought the hill of Samaria... and he fortified the hill and built the city..."

questions.question: Who was the son of Omri who did more evil than all before him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:30 (ESV): "And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD, more than all who were before him."

questions.question: How did Zimri die?
options: He burned the king's house over himself with fire
questions.correctAnswer: He burned the king's house over himself with fire
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:18 (ESV): "...he went into the citadel of the king's house and burned the king's house over him with fire and died."

questions.question: Who did Ahab marry?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:31 (ESV): "...he took for his wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians..."

questions.question: What god did Ahab serve and worship?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:31 (ESV): "...and went and served Baal and worshipped him."

questions.question: Who rebuilt Jericho at the cost of his two sons?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:34 (ESV): "In his days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho. He laid its foundation at the cost of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub..."

questions.question: Who was Omri's rival for the throne?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:21 (ESV): "Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts. Half of the people followed Tibni... and half followed Omri."

questions.question: How long did Baasha reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:33 (ESV): "...Baasha... began to reign... and he reigned twenty-four years." (Confirmed by context in Ch 16).

questions.question: How long did Elah reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:8 (ESV): "...Elah... began to reign... and he reigned two years."

questions.question: How long did Omri reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:23 (ESV): "...Omri began to reign over Israel, and reigned for twelve years..."

questions.question: How much did Omri pay Shemer for the hill of Samaria?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:24 (ESV): "He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver..."

questions.question: How long did Ahab reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 16:29 (ESV): "...and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years."

key_verse_text: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver, and he fortified the hill and called the name of the city that he built Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill. (ESV)
